DP003.rationale: External effects are bounded. Federation connect uses wait_for(20) and connect_timeout=5 with backoff capped at 30 s; JetStream publish has timeout=5 and the outbox row is marked sent only after the ack; consumers use explicit ack, ack_wait=60 and max_deliver=20, and ingest is idempotent on the message id. git calls have timeout=60 and tmux calls timeout=10. The review found that the single-operator Bridge's NatsClient.connect had no timeout on the TCP connect or the INFO line; this change bounds both (CONNECT_TIMEOUT_S=5, a TimeoutError that run()'s backoff loop catches), covered by BridgeConnectBounded in hub/tests/test_hub_offline.py.

DP004.rationale: The hub socket identifies callers by peer uid (SO_PEERCRED/LOCAL_PEERCRED) and process ancestry; the TCP listener is loopback-only, needs a token compared with hmac.compare_digest, and ignores a claimed 'as'. Secrets are written 0600 under umask 077. Federation takes the sender from subject token 3 and the server enforces it with per-user publish ACLs; redact.scrub blocks or redacts secrets outbound and privileged_gate fails closed. The review found that the dashboard checked Origin on writes but not Host on any request, so a DNS-rebinding page could read /api/stream/<agent> terminal content; this change adds Handler.host_allowed (421 for any Host other than its own 127.0.0.1/localhost port), covered by dashboard/test_host_guard.py. The hub/fed/demo.py and test strings that look like keys are fake redaction inputs.

DP006.rationale: Operators see federation state through 'agentmux hub fed status/audit/quarantine'; Runtime.last_error records connect failures and every guard decision lands in fed_audit. The dashboard Federation panel shows peers, holds (alert after hold_alert_s=300) and a kill switch that survives restarts, with 'resume' to recover. Store._migrate takes a pre-migration backup. Targets are measurable: ack_wait 60 s, presence TTL 90 s, and orchestration scoreboards in evals/orchestrations/SCOREBOARD.md.
